claims.gist: Five product capabilities will sell themselves in 2026
The security industry is highly reactionary
Phylum and Socket did early hard work detecting OSS malware
Supply chain malware detection was ahead of its time
Teams did not understand malware versus vulnerabilities
Developer adoption of NPM wrappers and firewalls is extremely low
Shai Hulud attacks compromised thousands of organizations
Supply chain malware is now a priority in AppSec assessments
Many vulnerability management startups consolidated in 2025
Selling a tool to manage tools as point solution is hard
2025 saw an explosion of AI-driven vulnerability management approaches
Newer AI remediation tools tie to budgetable outcomes
Agentic systems rapidly increase AI risk
Most of industry does not know what good AI security is
Most tools in 2026 offer basic AI visibility
Provider guardrails will outgrow security-specific tools
Code-instrumented guardrails are best left to major AI providers
DAST providers are adding LLM red teaming
LLM testing will be a major 2026 driver
AI is excellent at analyzing code for security flaws
AI-based detections are a categorical improvement everywhere deployed

thesis: Supply chain malware detection, AI remediation, AI security testing and AI-based detections will dominate 2026 security purchasing.
